contract: Play MP4 tx3g and Matroska UTF-8, ASS/SSA or WebVTT to EOF through Player and TextBridge. Compare with live av_read_frame and the text decoders of the pinned FFmpeg formats build.

Fold emitted cue bytes and presentation and duration clocks with an explicit unknown marker in microseconds, plus WebVTT identifiers and settings. The ASS packet is opaque. For WebVTT, compare the demuxer's typed side data or the type-1 BlockAdditional exposed by its Matroska API; for the plain-text comparison project the decoded ASS Text field by resolving line and space escapes and removing override blocks. A source cue can preserve literal markup, zero or unknown durations and signed timestamps that the reference decoder or demuxer changes.
Preload the container on both sides. Opening and reading the container, decoding, folding and teardown are inside the operation.

open_deviations.reading: A zero-length timed-text string has a source cue extent
open_deviations.clause: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.17 delimits text by a 16-bit byte count and requires the remaining sample bytes to be modifier boxes.
open_deviations.candidate: Emits a zero-byte cue at the listed sample time and retains any subsequent cues.
open_deviations.reference: Suppresses the empty sample. In one two-packet case the next visible cue is b at 1001000 us.
open_deviations.compat: compat::text::suppress_empty_tx3g for consumers that only want visible cues.

open_deviations.reading: Opaque ASS source bytes survive demux
open_deviations.clause: RFC 9559 section 10.1 defines Block data. Matroska codec mappings draft 21 sections 3.5.7 and 5.3 store ASS event fields in that data.
open_deviations.candidate: Exposes the zero-byte block or the unchanged legacy or invalid-UTF-8 ASS bytes to the client.
open_deviations.reference: Publishes no decoded subtitle for these packets.
open_deviations.compat: compat::text::decoded_ass_events for clients that require decoder admission before receiving an event.

open_deviations.reading: Byte-counted text preserves line and nonprinting scalars
open_deviations.clause: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 sections 5.1–5.2 and 5.17 define the UTF-8 or BOM-marked UTF-16 string as a byte-counted field.
open_deviations.candidate: Keeps CR, LF and U+0000 in the extracted UTF-8 string, including a NUL between a and b and a leading NUL before tail.
open_deviations.reference: Stops the published string at NUL or changes the line breaks in the display-text projection.
open_deviations.compat: compat::text::c_string_display for callers that need the reference display string.

open_deviations.reading: Timed-text bytes remain separate from presentation modifiers
open_deviations.clause: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.17 delimits text by a 16-bit byte count and requires the remaining sample bytes to be modifier boxes. Section 5.17.1.1 stores styles as modifier records.
open_deviations.candidate: For the markup fixture preserves all 13 source bytes. For the font-table case returns abcdef.
open_deviations.reference: The decoded display projection normalizes the markup fixture to six bytes and returns a literal closing brace in a}bcdef.

open_deviations.reading: BOM-marked big-endian UTF-16 decodes to Unicode scalars
open_deviations.clause: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 sections 5.1–5.2 and 5.17 define the UTF-8 or BOM-marked UTF-16 string as a byte-counted field.
open_deviations.candidate: Returns full decoded UTF-8, including the ASCII, Hangul and supplementary-plane controls.
open_deviations.reference: Returns no cue for the four valid UTF-16 samples.

open_deviations.reading: Physical timed-text box layouts remain bounded by the sample
open_deviations.clause: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.17 delimits text by a 16-bit byte count and requires the remaining sample bytes to be modifier boxes. ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 section 4.2 defines compact, extended and end-of-file box sizes.
open_deviations.candidate: Accepts the valid bounded modifier layouts and retains abcd or x.
open_deviations.reference: Suppresses the cue on the complete sample with these layouts.

open_deviations.reading: A truncated timed-text length field supplies no string
open_deviations.clause: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.17 delimits text by a 16-bit byte count and requires the remaining sample bytes to be modifier boxes.
open_deviations.candidate: Reports a source refusal before emitting any cue.
open_deviations.reference: Emits no cue and completes successfully.

open_deviations.reading: A sample does not cover the bytes claimed by its string length
open_deviations.clause: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.17 delimits text by a 16-bit byte count and requires the remaining sample bytes to be modifier boxes.
open_deviations.candidate: Refuses before publishing text rather than treating a partial string as complete.
open_deviations.reference: Publishes the available prefix, such as xy, ab or xy in the short controls.
open_deviations.compat: compat::text::recover_truncated_tx3g for consumers showing a partial source string.

open_deviations.reading: A malformed modifier cannot extend past its sample
open_deviations.clause: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.17 delimits text by a 16-bit byte count and requires the remaining sample bytes to be modifier boxes. ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 section 4.2 defines the length of each complete box.
open_deviations.candidate: Refuses the invalid suffix after the length-delimited text.
open_deviations.reference: Ignores the invalid box extent and emits x, abcd or a, or suppresses a sample with an incomplete box header.
open_deviations.compat: compat::text::ignore_invalid_tx3g_modifiers for consumers needing prefix text from broken modifiers.

open_deviations.reading: A timed-text string must be well-formed in its signaled encoding
open_deviations.clause: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 sections 5.1–5.2 and 5.17 define the UTF-8 or BOM-marked UTF-16 string as a byte-counted field. RFC 3629 sections 3–4 forbid overlong UTF-8 and surrogate encodings. TS 126 245 section 5.1 makes byte-reversed UTF-16 support optional.
open_deviations.candidate: Refuses malformed UTF-8, unpaired or incomplete UTF-16, or the unsupported reverse BOM.
open_deviations.reference: Suppresses the sample without the source refusal, or decodes a valid prefix before NUL. It continues to a later cue in the two-packet malformed UTF-8 control.
open_deviations.compat: compat::text::skip_invalid_tx3g for clients that need to resume after malformed string data.

open_deviations.reading: Matroska UTF-8 extraction retains the complete Block text
open_deviations.clause: Matroska codec mappings draft 21 sections 3.5.11 and 5.2 store the UTF-8 subtitle text in the Block data. RFC 3629 section 3 encodes U+0000 as one byte and does not assign it a string-terminator role.
open_deviations.candidate: Retains the UTF-8 BOM, embedded NUL and later bytes, or the literal angle-bracket markup.
open_deviations.reference: Stops at NUL or strips apparent markup in the display projection.
open_deviations.compat: compat::text::decoded_utf8_display for clients needing the normalized display string.

open_deviations.reading: Matroska UTF-8 rejects a scalar above U+10FFFF
open_deviations.clause: Matroska codec mappings draft 21 sections 3.5.11 and 5.2 store the UTF-8 subtitle text in the Block data. RFC 3629 section 3 confines the encoded scalar range to U+0000 through U+10FFFF.
open_deviations.candidate: Refuses the text call on invalid UTF-8.
open_deviations.reference: Emits no cue and completes successfully.

open_deviations.reading: A known zero source duration remains a value
open_deviations.clause: ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 section 8.6.1.2.1 stores sample deltas, including zero. RFC 9559 section 5.1.3.5.3 defines explicit BlockDuration in Track Ticks.
open_deviations.candidate: Emits duration zero, with presence retained.
open_deviations.reference: Supplies no duration when its packet duration field is zero.

open_deviations.reading: Signed Matroska subtitle Block time is preserved
open_deviations.clause: RFC 9559 section 11.2 defines the signed relative Block timestamp and presentation arithmetic.
open_deviations.candidate: Returns the source cue at -715000 us with a duration of 333000 us.
open_deviations.reference: Reports the same cue and duration with PTS zero.
open_deviations.compat: compat::matroska::clamp_negative_subtitle_pts for callers needing the reference projected time.

open_deviations.reading: Timed text retains the unsigned stts delta
open_deviations.clause: ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 sections 8.6.1.2.2–8.6.1.2.3 define sample_delta as an unsigned 32-bit count.
open_deviations.candidate: Reports 4294967295000000 us for the coded 4294967295-tick duration at one tick per second.
open_deviations.reference: Reports 1000000 us for the same one-byte cue.

open_deviations.reading: WebVTT payload carries its inline timestamp syntax
open_deviations.clause: Matroska codec mappings draft 21 sections 5.4.3 and 5.4.5.2–5.4.5.5 define cue payload carriage including transformed inline timestamps.
open_deviations.candidate: Returns all 19 bytes of the payload including the relative inline timestamp.
open_deviations.reference: Returns only the eight bytes of the visible word relative.

open_deviations.reading: A WebVTT BlockAdditional needs its settings and identifier lines
open_deviations.clause: Matroska codec mappings draft 21 section 5.4.4 defines newline-delimited settings and identifier records in type-1 BlockAdditional.
open_deviations.candidate: Refuses the incomplete additional record at the source boundary.
open_deviations.reference: Decodes and publishes the four-byte cue body without the invalid additional fields.

open_deviations.reading: An empty timed-text sample preserves its source interval
open_deviations.clause: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.17 permits a zero string byte count. ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 sections 8.6.1.2 and 8.8.8 keep the sample interval.
open_deviations.candidate: Emits empty cues at 0 and 2600000 us around the nonempty 2400000-us cue.
open_deviations.reference: Publishes only the nonempty cue at 200000 us.
open_deviations.compat: compat::text::suppress_empty_tx3g for consumers that only want visible cues.

open_deviations.reading: A noncharacter is valid in a well-formed text string
open_deviations.clause: Unicode Corrigendum 9 and RFC 3629 sections 3–4 distinguish noncharacters from invalid UTF-8. ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.1 defines character decoding.
open_deviations.candidate: Returns the UTF-8 scalar U+FFFE as efbfbe.
open_deviations.reference: Suppresses the cue.

open_deviations.reading: A bounded unknown modifier leaves timed text readable
open_deviations.clause: ETSI TS 126 245 V19.0.0 section 5.17 skips unrecognized modifier boxes. ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 section 4.2 defines a size-zero box extending through the enclosing end.
open_deviations.candidate: Keeps cue a at 0 and cue b at 1001000 us. The unknown zzzz modifier only occupies the remaining bytes of the first sample.
open_deviations.reference: Refuses the first sample with an invalid box size and publishes only b.
